# Qatar eVTOL — full data

> Independent primary-source reference for eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) infrastructure in Qatar: operators, aircraft, vertiports, routes, regulators. Every claim traces to a named primary source (operator press releases, regulator filings, government statements). No aggregation, no invented launch dates.

Generated: 2026-05-20T06:55:55.535Z. Each entity lists status, location, last-verified date and primary sources.


## EHang EH216-S (Qatar trials)
Type: aircraft | Status: trial-only | City: Doha | Country: Qatar | Last verified: 2026-08-22
Coordinates: 25.36091, 51.52474

## Port of Doha ↔ Katara Cultural Village
Type: route | Status: trial_only | City: Doha | Country: Qatar | Last verified: 2026-08-22
Coordinates: 25.3174, 51.5378
Summary: The EHang EH216-S completed first urban human-carrying pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East between Port of Doha and Katara Cultural Village on 17 November 2025. 8-minute flight vs ~30 minutes by car.
Primary sources:
- EHang IR — EH216-S Conducts First Urban Human-Carrying Pilotless eVTOL Flights in the Middle East, Partnering with Qatar's Ministry of Transport (17 Nov 2025) (operator-ir), accessed 2026-05-20: https://www.ehang.com/news/1310.html

## Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA)
Type: regulator | Status: operational | City: Doha | Country: Qatar | Last verified: 2026-08-22
Coordinates: 25.2854, 51.531
Summary: The Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA) issued operational authorization for EHang EH216-S first urban pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East on 17 November 2025. Distinct from MoT.
